translation: It also says: The vessel of Changyang (i.e. Fuliu, KI7) makes a person suffer lumbar pain, the pain drawing into the chest, the eyes dazed (mangmang), and in severe cases the body folds backward and the tongue curls so that one cannot speak. Puncture the inner sinew with three points (san wei), above the inner ankle, in front of the great sinew, behind Taiyin, at the place two cun up the ankle. Wang Qixuan said: The Yin Qiao rises from behind Rangu, ascends above the inner ankle, follows the inner thigh into the genitals, and, following the abdomen, enters the interior of the chest and the supraclavicular fossa, ascends out in front of Renying, enters the inner border of the cheek, connects to the inner canthus of the eye, and joins with Taiyang and the Yang Qiao, then ascends — and therefore the disease signs are as such.
